Author: platis
Name: XIV.fm
Punchline: Share what you are listening to in Final Fantasy XIV.
Description: XIV.fm displays Last.fm listening presence on cards anchored above player nameplates.
Changelog:
- Cards now size dynamically to their title and artist, up to the existing maximum width.
- Text-only cards no longer reserve blank space for unavailable cover artwork.
- Reduces card height by 10%, enlarges artwork and typography by 20%, and tightens line spacing.
